data.title: 久岛鸥 · 白色沙滩上的水花嬉戏
data.description: 无人的隐秘海滩上，阳光将细沙烤得发烫。鸥在浅水区踢起一片晶莹的水花，转过身来双手叉腰，条纹比基尼勾勒出娇俏可人的身段，笑声如同风铃般清脆。
data.location: remote pristine white sand cove with crystal clear shallow turquoise water
data.action: kicking up glistening water droplets with bare feet, hands on hips, laughing heartily in blue-and-white striped bikini
data.lighting: dazzling tropical sunshine creating caustic light patterns through transparent seawater
data.mood: exuberant summer vitality, playful girlish radiance, sun-drenched coastal joy
data.promptProse: Splashing crystal clear ocean water with bare feet, Kamome laughs freely in her striped bikini under the bright midday tropical sky.
data.animaCaption: Kamome kicking up sea spray playfully in her striped bikini on a sunny beach.
